title: A Verifier Can Leak the Answer: Diagnosability Before Optimization in Closed-Loop Agent Debugging
abstract: arXiv:2610.00126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent developers increasingly compare prompts, tools, policies, and diagnosis algorithms through simulator-grounded verifiers. A verifier can nevertheless make a solver comparison vacuous: if its probes or predicates encode the target identity, an exact optimizer may appear effective without resolving any genuine ambiguity. We report such a failure in an aggregate-trace debugger for a closed-loop decision agent. Exact minimum hitting set (MHS) and a propagation-aware greedy method returned identical supports in 12/12 development cases and the same planted-fault recovery in 9/12. A subsequent audit found that exact-anchor predicates produced the planted pair in 9/9 cases. After removing those anchors, overall planted-pair recovery was 8/9; hard-probe singleton pairs nevertheless matched the planted pair in 9/9, and no case retained a nonempty residual conflict family after propagation (0/9). translated_title: 验证器可能泄露答案：闭环智能体调试中优化之前的可诊断性问题
translated_abstract: 智能体开发者越来越多地通过基于模拟器的验证器来比较提示词、工具、策略和诊断算法。然而，验证器可能会使求解器之间的比较变得毫无意义：如果它的探测项或谓词编码了目标身份，精确优化器就可能显得有效，而实际上并未解决任何真正的歧义。作者在一个闭环决策智能体的聚合轨迹调试器中报告了这样一种失败案例。精确最小命中集（MHS）方法与一种传播感知的贪心方法在12/12个开发案例中返回了相同的支持集，并在9/12个案例中实现了相同的植入故障恢复。随后的审计发现，精确锚点谓词在9/9个案例中都直接产生了植入故障对。移除这些锚点后，总体植入对恢复率为8/9；然而，硬探测单例对仍在9/9个案例中与植入对完全匹配，且没有任何案例在传播后保留非空的残余冲突族（0/9）。优化器本身是正确的，但验证器……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 论文揭示了闭环智能体调试中验证器的探测与谓词可能泄露植入故障答案，从而使精确优化器看似有效实则无意义，强调在比较优化算法之前必须先审计验证器的可诊断性。
en_tdlr: Simulator-grounded verifiers can leak the planted answer through their probes and predicates, making solver comparisons vacuous; this paper argues that verifier diagnosability must be audited before optimizing solvers in closed-loop agent debugging.
